title: dev.superpipeline.gate.outcome.v1
description: The receipt that closes a gate's (or a follow-up's) card once the board accepted a decision, referencing the event the card was drawn from. decided_by is the person's label, never an mxid; null when nobody in the room decided it. Readers ignore properties they do not know.

decision.description: What closed the gate (or follow-up). A person's decision is the option id they chose; expired and cancelled are closed by the board with nobody deciding (decided_by null): expired when what the gate approves passed its expiry, cancelled when the card was moved or archived while the gate was pending. A follow-up is settled with record_live_url, switch_to_automatic or settled_elsewhere. Open to readers: a value not listed in x-treaty-known-values is valid and closes the card all the same, said generically, never dropped.
